name: virtual-office
description: Oficina virtual 2D multijugador (React + NestJS + Socket.IO + Janus WebRTC + PostgreSQL)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vo/shared && npm run build -w @vo/server && npm run build -w @vo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vo/server && npm run typecheck -w @vo/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @vo/shared && npm test -w @vo/shared && npm test -w @vo/server && npm test -w @vo/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @vo/shared && npm run dev -w @vo/server
